naive_scope: One bit per nominal known operation/eligible machine/legal mode/integer start; all other variable families excluded

mechanisms.name: machine/mode/certification
mechanisms.naive: Machine-mode-start alternatives counted below; operation one-hot and machine-time conflicts required
mechanisms.local: Candidates are prevalidated against current machine, wear, mode and certification; at most one bit per offered start

mechanisms.name: qualified worker calendars
mechanisms.naive: Additional crew/attendance assignment variables and time-indexed capacity or pair conflicts; not counted
mechanisms.local: Classical availability filtering and explicit shared attendance interval conflicts; zero auxiliary bits for pair conflicts

mechanisms.name: portable tools and service
mechanisms.naive: Location, movement, remaining life and service decisions across time; not counted
mechanisms.local: Current tool identity/life/location frozen at boundary; shared tools generate pair conflicts; relocation/service scheduled classically

mechanisms.name: finite buffers and blocked outputs
mechanisms.naive: Inventory/reservation occupancy and pickup release across time; not counted
mechanisms.local: Destination reservations and blocking replayed classically; local candidates inherit fixed boundary feasibility

mechanisms.name: AGV lanes/traction/chargers
mechanisms.naive: Vehicle, departure, route/edge-time, payload and charge variables; not counted
mechanisms.local: Classical transport planner and checker, outside current start-selection QUBO; no claimed global quantum compression

mechanisms.name: BOM assembly and batch identity
mechanisms.naive: Matching/consumption and batch membership/activation variables; not counted
mechanisms.local: Classical BOM matching and homogeneous ready batches; QUBO does not choose all alternative assembly plans

mechanisms.name: power capacity
mechanisms.naive: Time-indexed capacity rows plus slack/other inequality encoding
mechanisms.local: Residual integer-centikW capacity rows; exact GCD scaling, redundant row removal, pair-only capacity-one rows, otherwise bounded binary slack

mechanisms.name: battery/energy/carbon
mechanisms.naive: SOC/action balances and objective coefficients across time; not counted
mechanisms.local: Classical causal battery actions; grid feasibility checked on full trace; energy cost/carbon reported separately

mechanisms.name: uncertainty/quality/rework
mechanisms.naive: Contingent activity slots/scenario copies plus nonanticipativity constraints; not counted
mechanisms.local: Causal simulation, keyed quality and revealed shocks; local boundary contains only observed state; future not encoded

mechanisms.name: priced tool rental
mechanisms.local: High-level causal policy controls request; hard investment budget and lead time independently replayed

reduction_scope: Conditional dispatch candidate-pool decomposition; not a lossless global factory encoding
price_of_restriction: Global loss unknown; compare same-model classical incumbents and scoped exact tiny references

measured_local.note: These maxima describe local problems actually offered; they exclude classical scheduling/transport/controller work

fulfillment_primary_certificate.scope: Zero missing orders proves primary fulfillment optimality for this realized trace only; secondary cost/tardiness and policy-wide optimality remain unproved
